headline: Football | Greenfield and King City lead divisions
summary: SALINAS VALLEY — The Greenfield Bruins are in a first-place tie with Seaside at 3-0 in the Santa Lucia Division and the King City Mustangs are 1-0 at the start of the Mission-South Division in high school football.
source: King City Rustler / South County Newspapers
